Bath. 9ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Moed Katan 11a:14-20">M. Kat. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>כוורא … ולא ליטעון פ׳</he> after fish, cresses and milk, let the body be laden but not the bed (walk but do not lie down).
Keth. 10ᵇ (etymol.) פ׳ שפרין וכ׳ the bed is called puria, because on it men multiply and increase; a. fr.—
